excludedFromThisProfile.handle: Class has no handle choice: the grip is part of the frame (CLS-WGL-003). No Handle attribute is declared.
excludedFromThisProfile.sourceRefs: 438 / 439 come from the manifest and hold no Class rows. The colour catalogs are read from the configurator the manifest names; Class has no configurator of its own yet, so it reads Mako's 9 and offers only the colours that appear there. Configurator 8 is named for Class but is still a copy of 9.
excludedFromThisProfile.heightByStyle: Confirmed: 1DW and 1DWID are 40 cm high, 2DW is 52 cm (CLS-XLS-005/006/007). This is a cabinet table row, and table 439 has no Class rows.
excludedFromThisProfile.widths: Confirmed: Sink Base 60/80/100/120 cm, Side Cabinet 40/60/80/100/120 cm, depth 52 cm (CLS-XLS-002/003/008). Cabinet table rows.
excludedFromThisProfile.integratedSb60WithInnerDrawer: Confirmed: a 60 cm Sink Base with 1DWID is not available with an Integrated countertop (CLS-WGL-006). The profile has no width x style x countertop style rule.
excludedFromThisProfile.compositionLimits: Confirmed: at most 220 cm long, at most two Sink Bases, cabinets abut only (CLS-WGL-007/008/009). Not expressible in the profile yet.
excludedFromThisProfile.floatingCountertop: Confirmed for thick countertops only (CLS-WGL-010); positions and the thick profile list are open (Q-CLASS-041/042).
excludedFromThisProfile.thickness: The GB table and the price workbook disagree (4 vs 4.7, .8 vs 3/4, 3.1 vs 3-1/8), so no thickness catalog is declared (Q-CLASS-033/042).
excludedFromThisProfile.basinByMaterialAndMinWidth: Confirmed in GB: material -> integrated basin codes and the minimum Sink Base width (60 cm, 80 cm for VA023) (section 0.8). Needs Class rows in the countertop table.
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselCutoutAndBrackets: A vessel cutout per Sink Base and two brackets for thick countertops are order lines, not options (CLS-WGL-013, CLS-XLS-022).
excludedFromThisProfile.colorToSkuMaterial: Cabinet Color, Cabinet Side Color and Frame Color map to CABF / CABS / FRM, but the value -> material code -> colour code join and the /B or /C price class are not given (Q-CLASS-004/006/032).
excludedFromThisProfile.solidSurfaceAliases: Matte White and Matte White 8cm are not joined to SSTL / SSTM / SSTEX / SSTMT (Q-CLASS-016).
excludedFromThisProfile.va030: VA030 is priced for SSTEX but absent from the Master File, so it is not offered (section 6.6).
excludedFromThisProfile.faucetHolePositions: Only the counts 0-3 are confirmed; positions, spacing and diameters are not (section 0.8).
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselStyleAssets: Iris, Frame and Plaza are named; their SKU, prices, colours and assets are not given (Q-CLASS-043).
